name: Avenger

specialAbility.name: Justice Strike
specialAbility.description: Avenger powers up with the force of justice, boosting its smash damage to punish any truck that dares to fight dirty!

lore: When the arena needs a hero, Avenger answers the call! Decked out in bold red, white, and blue, this patriotic powerhouse fights for the little trucks and never backs down from a bully. Its Justice Strike has saved countless matches, and the crowd always goes wild when those red-white-and-blue stripes come roaring onto the track!
